BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;


SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the Blrl Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications
as shown on Map No.
26-H in the area bounded by

                A line of 149.30 feet South of and parallel to West 105th Street; The alley next east of
               and parallel to North Western Avenue; A line 199.30 feet South of and parallel to West
               105th Street; and South Western Avenue.


to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.
